title: roster order (draft, from docs/architecture/d1-roster-data.md section 3)
description: data/fighters/roster.json: the select-screen order and the default pairing, a bare array of fighter ids. DRAFT: derived from the D1 plan before any data exists. Policy: closed. Open question for Simulation: a bare array cannot carry a version field; if the file becomes an object ({"schema": "roster/1", "order": [...]}) this schema and the roster cross-reference change with it. Every id must have data/fighters/<id>/fighter.json (checked by tools/lib/xref.js).
